div.head: II Cn 46.1
div.ab: Yfel byð, þæt man rihtfæstentide ær mæle ete, ⁊ gyt wyrse, þæt man mid flæscmete hine sylfne afyle.
Yfel bið hit, þæt man fæstentide ær mæle éte, ⁊ gyt hit bið wyrse, þæt man mid flæscmete hine [sylfne] gefyle.
Yfel byð, þæt man fæstentide ær mæle ete, ⁊ git wyrse, þæt man mid flæscmete hine sylfne afyle.
Malum est, ut tempore ieiuniorum ante horam comedat, et adhuc deterius, ut carnis cibo quis se ipsum inquinet.
Si seruus ieiunium uiolauerit carnem manducando, uerberetur secundum modum culpę.
[46, 1] Malum quidem est, ut quis die ieiunii ante horam commedit, peius uero, se ut escis carnium inquinet.
Yfel bið hit þæt man fæstentide ær mæle éte, ⁊ gyt hit bið wyrse þæt man mid flæscmete hine sylfne gefyle.
Yfel byð, þæt man rihtfæstentide ær mæle ete, and gyt wyrse þæt man mid flæscmete hine sylfne afyle.
Schlimm ist es, dass jemand zur gesetzlichen Fastenzeit vor Essenszeit esse, und noch schlimmer (ist es B), dass sich jemand mit Fleischgenuss besudele.
It is bad that anyone should eat before mealtime in a lawful fast, and still worse (is it, B) that anyone should defile himself with meat.
It is wrong for anyone during a fast to eat before the appointed time, and it is still worse for anyone to defile himself with flesh.
It is wrong that one should eat during a legally appointed fasting-season before the mealtime, and still worse, that one should defile oneself with fleshmeat.
During a legally mandated fast, it is sinful for anyone to eat before the appropriate time, and still worse for anyone to befoul himself with flesh.
